## Emergency Supply Fairness Engine (Luxe Logic)
1. Load synthetic ward, warehouse, road and ledger data
2. Score need, road access and fairness debt; build Plan A (need-based) and Plan B (minimum-coverage)
3. Compare plans and write the Fairness Report
4. Apply the approved plan and update the fairness-debt ledger

All numbers come from deterministic Code nodes. Telegram approval and LLM report writing are the next planned steps.
